scope: Already captured two-rank isolated Attention operators and a two-layer random Qwen2 Runner; diagnostic correctness and execution-path comparison only
association_method: Join exact torch_to_npu flow IDs within each trace; assign source points to a same-thread CPU scope; match the destination to an exact device pid/tid/timestamp duration slice. Host time containment is not used to assign device tasks.
clock_and_interpretation_limits: Ranks are independently exported. Absolute timestamps and flow endpoint differences are not a calibrated cross-rank time base.
Flow IDs connect Host and Device within one export. They do not connect peers across ranks.
HCCL task names, group-operation sequence and dtype/count cross-check semantic pairing; they do not calibrate clocks or identify which peer caused a wait.

Collective signature fields are raw exporter values. The isolated DCP capture exports rank_size=0 despite the known two-rank harness; use job topology for world size. Raw count is not a measured wire-byte total.
HCCL parent/AICPU durations include more than wire transfer and overlap transport subranges; do not sum nested ranges or infer link bandwidth.
EVENT RECORD/WAIT are stream synchronization controls, not extra Attention kernels. A Group Communication track is not a physical stream number.
A longer Host or HCCL slice does not establish the slowest rank, straggler, peer-wait root cause, throughput, or speedup.
PCP head-tail query placement and approximate causal work balance are source/layout properties; these captures do not expose query positions or prove per-rank runtime balance.
FIA CPU calls and flow-associated device tasks are recorded separately. A missing associated device task does not establish an empty query, skipped calculation, dropped sample, or failure.
FIA counts below mean tasks/calls observed inside the matched scope. They are not a direct measurement of valid queries or requests.

limits: An inferred forward ordinal is a position inside the captured interval, not a profiler-recorded scheduler global step.

runner_pcp.observed_fia_asymmetry_note: In these matched scopes both ranks have one FIA CPU call. Rank0 has one flow-associated FIA device task and rank1 has none, while both participate in two BF16 AllGather parents with count64. This observation does not establish an empty query, skipped calculation, dropped sample, failure, exact query ownership, or peer-wait cause.
runner_pcp.correctness_scope: The Runner records engine-level chosen tokens/logprobs, not independent per-rank intermediate Attention oracles. See tiny-comparison.json. The isolated operator experiment supplies the per-rank numeric Attention checks.

host_clock_evidence.source: Existing profiler_info start_info/end_info and paired host/device metadata from the same local multiprocess captures; host identifier and local paths omitted.

formulas.reported_difference: rank1 conversion offset minus rank0 conversion offset, in ns

host_clock_evidence.interpretation: The observed differences support close agreement of the two processes’ Host clock conversions. Preserve exported absolute timestamps; rank-local first-event zeroing is only a UI locator and does not align peers.
host_clock_evidence.limitation: These offset differences are not measured upper bounds on Host-to-device or cross-device timestamp error. They do not verify a calibrated common device clock or identify which rank caused a collective wait.
